import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path=Path('results/training/qwen38_dtype_probe.json')
assert not path.exists(), 'Inspect any existing submission before restarting'
completion=Path('results/training/qwen38_seed0_completion.json')
assert json.loads(completion.read_text())['status']=='completed_outputs_verified'
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_dtype_probe')
meta=json.loads((folder/'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert meta['is_private'] and meta['enable_internet'] and meta['enable_gpu']
env={**os.environ,'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR':str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'):
    env.pop(name,None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python','scripts/kaggle_quota.py'],env=env,check=True)
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text())
quota=snapshot['quota'];available=quota['gpu_seconds_total']-quota['gpu_seconds_used']-quota['gpu_seconds_reserved']
other=json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_primary_sft_validation.json').read_text())
remaining_other_cap=max(0,11100-(datetime.now(timezone.utc)-datetime.fromisoformat(other['submitted_at'])).total_seconds()) if other['status']=='submitted' else 0
reserve=33000
command=['kaggle','kernels','push','-p',str(folder),'--accelerator','NvidiaTeslaT4','--timeout','3000']
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Training-state BF16 to FP32 performance probe; reserve primary validation and test'},'8aa5f05d26b7205477066e1449e0af13f762a299'),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'completion_sha256':file_sha256(completion),
        'plan_sha256':file_sha256(Path('results/training/qwen38_dtype_probe_plan.json')),
        'metadata':meta,'source_sha256':file_sha256(folder/meta['code_file']),
        'quota_snapshot':snapshot,'available_seconds':available,'remaining_primary_sft_validation_cap_seconds':remaining_other_cap,
        'remaining_primary_evaluation_reserve_seconds':reserve,'session_timeout_seconds':3000,
        'scope':'Training-state latency only, 16 fixed states; no validation or test PnL.',
        'status':'admission_check','polls':[]}
assert available>=remaining_other_cap+reserve+3000,'Insufficient quota after primary reserve'
record.update(status='submitting',submitted_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
result=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
record['push']={'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'output':result.stdout,'error':result.stderr}
match=re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)',result.stdout)
actual=re.search(r'https://www.kaggle.com/code/([^/\s]+/[^/\s]+)',result.stdout)
if actual:
    record['requested_kernel']=meta['id'];meta['id']=actual[1];record['metadata']=meta
record.update(status='submitted' if result.returncode==0 and match else 'push_requires_inspection',version=int(match[1]) if match else None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert record['status']=='submitted','Inspect ambiguous submission before any retry'
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel':meta['id'],'version':record['version'],'accelerator':'T4 x2 requested',
    'start':None,'end':None,'hours':None,'submitted_at':record['submitted_at'],'private':True,'status':'submitted',
    'source_commit':record['provenance']['git_commit'],'receipt':str(path),'session_timeout_seconds':3000,
    'purpose':'Registered training-state dtype probe, no policy score.',
    'hours_basis':'Pending downloaded runtime; session cap is not measured usage.'})
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Submitted',meta['id'],'version',record['version'],flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/watch_kaggle.py','--receipt',str(path),'--out',
                f"results/kaggle/qwen38-dtype-probe-v{record['version']}"],check=True)
